snapshot.title: Implement mission progression updates from 2026-02-17 design notes
snapshot.description: Implement M1-M3 mission flow updates captured from handwritten product notes in .knowns/assets/IMG_1754.jpeg, .knowns/assets/IMG_1755.jpeg, and .knowns/assets/IMG_1756.jpeg: progression-aware mission selector, dedicated debrief screen, scanner introduction behavior, and target/rocket gating rules.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Players see mission options based on progression and rocket availability
M1-M3 flows behave per spec including scanner introduction timing
Post-mission debrief is available as a dedicated step
Work is split into trackable subtasks
